# Swell

> Swell makes premium ready-to-drink protein shakes that taste like a milkshake. Positioning: "The protein shake you actually want to drink." Swell 30g comes in a pink 14 fl oz bottle; Swell 50g comes in a bigger light-blue 16 fl oz bottle for heavy days. Both have collagen peptides, iron with vitamin C, and zero lactose.

## Key facts
- Swell 30g: 30 g protein, 170 calories, 0 g added sugar, 14 fl oz, pink bottle
- Swell 50g: 50 g protein, about 250 calories, 16 fl oz, light-blue bottle
- In every bottle: 25% of daily iron with 60 mg vitamin C, 2.5 g collagen peptides, lactose-free milk base
- Sweetened with allulose, monk fruit, stevia and a little sucralose; no ace-K, no carrageenan
- Flavors (5): Chocolate, Vanilla, Cookie Butter, Matcha, Peanut Butter. Matcha has natural caffeine.
- Price: $4.25 a Swell 30g and $4.99 a Swell 50g on subscription (every 2 or 4 weeks); $5 and $7 one time
- Buy: build a 12- or 24-bottle mixed box (reserve now, pay when it ships); free shipping on 24
- Swell Pass: a membership for Swell fridges, $19 a month with 5 fridge Swells included, member prices and points toward free Swells
- Swell fridges come after the online launch: smart fridges in Pilates studios, gyms, hotels and on campus
- Swell Creatine: single-serve sticks (Monohydrate, or Creatine + Electrolytes) to stir into a shake or water
- Ninja Creami: pour one bottle into a pint, freeze 24 hours, spin on Lite Ice Cream
- Contains milk. Peanut Butter contains peanuts.
